caption: The drawing features three separate statues rendered in grayscale with fine shading. All three objects appear to be classical sculptures, depicted against a plain, off-white background. The leftmost statue shows a draped human figure with missing head and lower arms, one hand positioned over the chest, and the robe flowing in pronounced folds. The central statue is a more intact standing figure, positioned on a rectangular pedestal, with an elongated neck and visible facial features; it wears a garment with armor-like details across the chest and shoulders. The rightmost statue depicts another draped human form, also missing its head, with the figure hunched over and clutching or supporting a smaller form, possibly a child or secondary figure, close to its body. Each statue is distinctly detailed with attention to the folds of the fabric and anatomical structure, and the overall composition arranges the three objects in a row from left to right, evenly spaced. The name "EDW. T. JEWETT" is written in small print in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Faith, Hope and Charity: Stone Figures from Facade of Mission
